description:
The About of a dataset: the owner's description plus a generated summary.

``summary_generated`` and ``highlights`` come from the version's schema and coordinate
summary (:func:`describe_dataset`); ``warnings_plain`` from its ingest issues and profile.

examples.description_user: Weekly media spend and revenue from the finance warehouse.
examples.summary_generated: Weekly data from 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-29 (104 weeks) for 10 markets and 3 channels, with 3 measures: revenue (the result you want to explain), spend (marketing spend) and price.

title: DatasetAbout
